Gal.3.28.bsb: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
Gal.3.28.kjv: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

Gal.5.17.bsb: For the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the flesh. They are opposed to each other, so that you do not do what you want.
Gal.5.17.kjv: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

Gal.3.22.bsb: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.
Gal.3.22.kjv: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

Gal.4.4.bsb: But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
Gal.4.4.kjv: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

Gal.4.5.bsb: to redeem those under the law, that we might receive our adoption as sons.
Gal.4.5.kjv: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

Gal.3.16.bsb: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
Gal.3.16.kjv: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

Gal.5.6.bsb: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. What matters is faith expressing itself through love.
Gal.5.6.kjv: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

Gal.5.22.bsb: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,
Gal.5.22.kjv: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

Gal.6.10.bsb: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to everyone, and especially to the family of faith.
Gal.6.10.kjv: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

Gal.5.13.bsb: For you, brothers, were called to freedom; but do not use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh. Rather, serve one another in love.
Gal.5.13.kjv: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

Gal.6.2.bsb: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
Gal.6.2.kjv: Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

Gal.5.14.bsb: The entire law is fulfilled in a single decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
Gal.5.14.kjv: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

Gal.4.6.bsb: And because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, “Abba, Father!”
Gal.4.6.kjv: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

Gal.4.26.bsb: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother.
Gal.4.26.kjv: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

Gal.3.26.bsb: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
Gal.3.26.kjv: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

Gal.3.29.bsb: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
Gal.3.29.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

Gal.4.7.bsb: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God.
Gal.4.7.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

Gal.4.14.bsb: And although my illness was a trial to you, you did not despise or reject me. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel of God, as if I were Christ Jesus Himself.
Gal.4.14.kjv: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

Gal.3.19.bsb: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions, until the arrival of the seed to whom the promise referred. It was administered through angels by a mediator.
Gal.3.19.kjv: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

Gal.5.19.bsb: The acts of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, and debauchery;
Gal.5.19.kjv: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

Gal.5.20.bsb: idolatry and sorcery; hatred, discord, jealousy, and rage; rivalries, divisions, factions,
Gal.5.20.kjv: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

Gal.5.21.bsb: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who practice such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
Gal.5.21.kjv: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

Gal.1.6.bsb: I am amazed how quickly you are deserting the One who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel—
Gal.1.6.kjv: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

Gal.1.7.bsb: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
Gal.1.7.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

Gal.3.1.bsb: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
Gal.3.1.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

Gal.4.9.bsb: But now that you know God, or rather are known by God, how is it that you are turning back to those weak and worthless principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?
Gal.4.9.kjv: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

Gal.4.11.bsb: I fear for you, that my efforts for you may have been in vain.
Gal.4.11.kjv: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

Gal.5.7.bsb: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
Gal.5.7.kjv: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

Gal.4.10.bsb: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
Gal.4.10.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

Gal.2.10.bsb: They only asked us to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.
Gal.2.10.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

Gal.4.8.bsb: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.
Gal.4.8.kjv: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

Gal.3.24.bsb: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Gal.3.24.kjv: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

Gal.4.1.bsb: What I am saying is that as long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a slave, although he is the owner of everything.
Gal.4.1.kjv: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

Gal.4.2.bsb: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the date set by his father.
Gal.4.2.kjv: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

Gal.1.13.bsb: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how severely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.
Gal.1.13.kjv: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

Gal.6.16.bsb: Peace and mercy to all who walk by this rule, even to the Israel of God.
Gal.6.16.kjv: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

Gal.2.9.bsb: And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John—those reputed to be pillars—gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
Gal.2.9.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

Gal.5.10.bsb: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is troubling you will bear the judgment, whoever he may be.
Gal.5.10.kjv: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

Gal.5.12.bsb: As for those who are agitating you, I wish they would proceed to emasculate themselves!
Gal.5.12.kjv: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

Gal.6.1.bsb: Brothers, if someone is caught in a trespass, you who are spiritual should restore him with a spirit of gentleness. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.
Gal.6.1.kjv: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

Gal.1.2.bsb: and all the brothers with me, To the churches of Galatia:
Gal.1.2.kjv: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

Gal.3.27.bsb: For all of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.
Gal.3.27.kjv: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

Gal.3.15.bsb: Brothers, let me put this in human terms. Even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.
Gal.3.15.kjv: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

Gal.3.10.bsb: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law.”
Gal.3.10.kjv: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

Gal.3.11.bsb: Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”
Gal.3.11.kjv: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

Gal.5.26.bsb: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
Gal.5.26.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

Gal.3.2.bsb: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?
Gal.3.2.kjv: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

Gal.3.3.bsb: Are you so foolish? After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?
Gal.3.3.kjv: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

Gal.3.4.bsb: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
Gal.3.4.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

Gal.3.5.bsb: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?
Gal.3.5.kjv: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

Gal.3.6.bsb: So also, “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.”
Gal.3.6.kjv: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

Gal.3.7.bsb: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
Gal.3.7.kjv: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

Gal.3.8.bsb: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and foretold the gospel to Abraham: “All nations will be blessed through you.”
Gal.3.8.kjv: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

Gal.3.9.bsb: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.
Gal.3.9.kjv: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

Gal.3.12.bsb: The law, however, is not based on faith; on the contrary, “The man who does these things will live by them.”
Gal.3.12.kjv: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

Gal.3.13.bsb: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us. For it is written: “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”
Gal.3.13.kjv: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

Gal.3.14.bsb: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.
Gal.3.14.kjv: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

Gal.3.17.bsb: What I mean is this: The law that came 430 years later does not revoke the covenant previously established by God, so as to nullify the promise.
Gal.3.17.kjv: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

Gal.3.18.bsb: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
Gal.3.18.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

Gal.3.20.bsb: A mediator is unnecessary, however, for only one party; but God is one.
Gal.3.20.kjv: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

Gal.3.21.bsb: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
Gal.3.21.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

Gal.3.23.bsb: Before this faith came, we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.
Gal.3.23.kjv: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

Gal.3.25.bsb: Now that faith has come, we are no longer under a guardian.
Gal.3.25.kjv: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

Gal.5.5.bsb: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the hope of righteousness.
Gal.5.5.kjv: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

Gal.2.16.bsb: know that a man is not justified by works of the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have believed in Christ Jesus, that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by works of the law, because by works of the law no one will be justified.
Gal.2.16.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

Gal.2.20.bsb: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.
Gal.2.20.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

Gal.1.1.bsb: Paul, an apostle—sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised Him from the dead—
Gal.1.1.kjv: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

Gal.1.3.bsb: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,
Gal.1.3.kjv: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

Gal.1.4.bsb: who gave Himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
Gal.1.4.kjv: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

Gal.2.6.bsb: But as for the highly esteemed—whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not show favoritism—those leaders added nothing to me.
Gal.2.6.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

Gal.5.18.bsb: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
Gal.5.18.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

Gal.5.23.bsb: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
Gal.5.23.kjv: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

Gal.5.25.bsb: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
Gal.5.25.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

Gal.6.8.bsb: The one who sows to please his flesh, from the flesh will reap destruction; but the one who sows to please the Spirit, from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
Gal.6.8.kjv: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

Gal.1.14.bsb: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
Gal.1.14.kjv: And profited in the Jews’ religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

Gal.1.15.bsb: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me by His grace, was pleased
Gal.1.15.kjv: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,

Gal.1.16.bsb: to reveal His Son in me so that I might preach Him among the Gentiles, I did not rush to consult with flesh and blood,
Gal.1.16.kjv: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

Gal.6.6.bsb: Nevertheless, the one who receives instruction in the word must share in all good things with his instructor.
Gal.6.6.kjv: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

Gal.6.5.bsb: For each one should carry his own load.
Gal.6.5.kjv: For every man shall bear his own burden.

Gal.6.7.bsb: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
Gal.6.7.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

Gal.6.9.bsb: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
Gal.6.9.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

Gal.1.8.bsb: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be under a curse!
Gal.1.8.kjv: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

Gal.1.9.bsb: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!
Gal.1.9.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

Gal.5.24.bsb: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
Gal.5.24.kjv: And they that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

Gal.5.15.bsb: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
Gal.5.15.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

Gal.4.16.bsb: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
Gal.4.16.kjv: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

Gal.1.11.bsb: For I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel I preached was not devised by man.
Gal.1.11.kjv: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

Gal.1.12.bsb: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.
Gal.1.12.kjv: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

Gal.6.4.bsb: Each one should test his own work. Then he will have reason to boast in himself alone, and not in someone else.
Gal.6.4.kjv: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

Gal.2.19.bsb: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live to God.
Gal.2.19.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

Gal.2.21.bsb: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
Gal.2.21.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

Gal.5.2.bsb: Take notice: I, Paul, tell you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no value to you at all.
Gal.5.2.kjv: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

Gal.5.4.bsb: You who are trying to be justified by the law have been severed from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
Gal.5.4.kjv: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

Gal.6.15.bsb: For neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything. What counts is a new creation.
Gal.6.15.kjv: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

Gal.6.13.bsb: For the circumcised do not even keep the law themselves, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.
Gal.6.13.kjv: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

Gal.2.2.bsb: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. But I spoke privately to those recognized as leaders, for fear that I was running or had already run in vain.
Gal.2.2.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

Gal.4.22.bsb: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.
Gal.4.22.kjv: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

Gal.4.24.bsb: These things serve as illustrations, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children into slavery: This is Hagar.
Gal.4.24.kjv: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

Gal.2.11.bsb: When Cephas came to Antioch, however, I opposed him to his face, because he stood condemned.
Gal.2.11.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

Gal.1.19.bsb: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
Gal.1.19.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

Gal.1.5.bsb: to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
Gal.1.5.kjv: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

Gal.2.14.bsb: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, “If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”
Gal.2.14.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

Gal.5.8.bsb: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
Gal.5.8.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

Gal.2.12.bsb: For before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself, for fear of those in the circumcision group.
Gal.2.12.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

Gal.2.3.bsb: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.
Gal.2.3.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

Gal.2.1.bsb: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, accompanied by Barnabas. I took Titus along also.
Gal.2.1.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

Gal.4.23.bsb: His son by the slave woman was born according to the flesh, but his son by the free woman was born through the promise.
Gal.4.23.kjv: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

Gal.2.17.bsb: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!
Gal.2.17.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

Gal.4.18.bsb: Nevertheless, it is good to be zealous if it serves a noble purpose—at any time, and not only when I am with you.
Gal.4.18.kjv: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

Gal.4.29.bsb: At that time, however, the son born by the flesh persecuted the son born by the Spirit. It is the same now.
Gal.4.29.kjv: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

Gal.2.15.bsb: We who are Jews by birth and not Gentile “sinners”
Gal.2.15.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

Gal.6.3.bsb: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
Gal.6.3.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
